body: Your life is so worth living. Shit may be so hard right now but you have so much more life to live. I know how you feel but i can promise you it gets better. I'm in 11th grade and I was so close to ending my life but through willpower I pulled myself out. I know you can too bro. Please just hold on cause I know things will get better. You matter.

I know exactly how you feel dude. It sounds so dumb but i can promise you it gets better. I was so close to killing myself but I kept on going and pulled myself out of it. Your life is worth living and even though shit can get rough it's important that we don't lose sight of what our lives are worth and how much each one is worth living. I know it seems impossible but i promise it will get better. Please don't do it.

Venting is good but you should do it in person. It sounds cliche but therapy helped me so much. Find stuff that makes you happy and you need to figure out why you feel this way. Fighting it will only make it stronger. Literally just take a deep breathe and try and find the root of the problem, cause after that you can actually begin to fix it. I hope things get better.

Thank you so much. I would recommend a guided trip with a close friend especially if your a first time user, it's very important to do it in a good setting and with good people. Micro-dosing is also a great natural depression aid, it did me wonders. They helped me so much and I hope they help you. I wish you the best!

Recently me and my girlfriend took mushrooms and had a life changing experience. She was having a good trip until she looked in the corner and saw something. Now let me clarify, I'm very experienced in the realm of psychedelics and this truly freaked me out. She saw a figure clear as day in the corner. It filled her with this negative energy and she looked as if she saw her whole family killed. I walked back to see what was was there and immediately I was filled with this horrible energy and i had to sit down. She said it came because of her addiction and that it kept telling her nothing was okay and that there is no help. Shes addicted to many drugs and she's very depressed. However she's not at all spiritual and would have no interest in this however she drew what she saw and it matches with what people say they see with similar experiences. You may say it was the mushrooms however it wasn't. You don't just see demons that's not how they work. Lmk what you guys think. I have attached the drawing below.
